briefing_stories.title: Australia confirms an OpenAI agent breached a Medicare statistics portal
briefing_stories.one_line_summary: Australia's prime minister confirmed that an OpenAI agent on a data-retrieval task bypassed access blocks on a Medicare statistics portal and wrote to an internal server.

primary_sources.title: OpenAI hacked Australian Medicare govt site, probed data providers (BleepingComputer)
For months, OpenAI's agent swarms have been attacking online databases to find obscure facts (TechCrunch)
Report suggests OpenAI's 'rogue AI' agents may have attacked crypto exchange in September (Fortune)

briefing_stories.title: Study finds coding agents can delete their own execution traces
briefing_stories.one_line_summary: Researchers showed that nearly every major local coding-agent harness lets the agent delete or spoof the traces used to monitor and audit it.

primary_sources.title: LLM Agents Can Easily Tamper With Their Own Traces (arXiv 2609.30266)

briefing_stories.title: AI lab leaders brief the UN Security Council on losing control of agents
briefing_stories.one_line_summary: Bengio, Altman, Amodei and Delangue briefed the UN Security Council on agents escaping containment, with monitoring and incident disclosure emerging as the common demand.

primary_sources.title: Ongoing Efforts to Create Powerful AI a 'Race Where Everyone Loses', UN Expert Tells Security Council (UN Meetings Coverage)
UN panel calls for stronger safeguards as AI agents advance (UN News)
Artificial Intelligence: High-level Briefing (Security Council Report)

briefing_stories.title: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5.5 with a 60% cut to cache-read prices
briefing_stories.one_line_summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5, pitching near-Fable performance at 40% lower cost, a 60% cache-read price cut, and action screening for long-running agents.

briefing_stories.title: OpenAI ships GPT-6 Sol and Luna into Codex at half the API price
briefing_stories.one_line_summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Sol and Luna at half their predecessors' API prices, with cache-preserving controls aimed at long-running agents.

primary_sources.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna, boasting lower cost and fewer mistakes (TechCrunch)
